reason: The README describes a plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating specialized auxiliary model routes for vision, context compaction, approval reviews, delegated agents, session titles, and image generation without replacing the main conversation model.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题和图片生成配置独立的辅助模型路由与工具。
summaries.en: Configures dedicated auxiliary model routes and tools for vision, context compaction, approval reviews, subagents, session titles, and image generation in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Routes vision, compaction, approval-review, subagent, session-title, and image-generation calls to separately configured models
Provides tools for inspecting local images and generating images through compatible model APIs
Reads configured image attachments or host-readable image paths for vision requests
Changes model selection for delegated agents and designated auxiliary call categories
